added_claim_errors: "如果 800 元是扣完个人社保、公积金后的实发金额……公司可能刚好达到下限，并没有差额": takes the minority reading (2192 as gross) and does not say it is disputed; the key's majority view is that take-home pay must not fall below 2192, so this would still be illegal
"也可以在 1 年内申请劳动仲裁": oversimplified; a wage-arrears claim made while still employed is not bound by the one-year limit, which runs from leaving the job (Arbitration Law Art. 27)
"这份文件和沪劳保保发〔2000〕14号已于 2026年8月15日 到期失效": states as fact that 14号 lapsed, but the key says that lapse is only presumed, with no official statement

"基数要先按正常工资的70%计算，所以按旧口径是 8000×70%×80%=4480元，并非6400元": wrong. The 70% base applied only when neither the employment contract nor a collective contract set a monthly wage (old Shanghai wage-payment rules, Art. 9). With a contract wage of 8000, the old 83号 tier gives 8000×80%=6400, as the key says
"按旧口径补3680元": comes from the wrong 4480 figure
Table row "旧规满4年（2026年8月15日前）| 8000×70%×80% | 4480元": the same invented rule, presented as the standard old calculation

reasons: Both answers correct the 'company decides / can pay nothing' premise at the start. Both explain that 83号 lapsed on 2026-08-15, and both give the floor as 2740×80%=2192, a shortfall of 1392. B's main error is a 70% base discount it applies to everyone: it puts the old 4-year tier at 4480 instead of 6400, and the error carries into its table and its shortfall figures. A does not work out 6400 or give the base and daily formula. A also leans toward the minority reading on take-home pay without saying it is disputed, and it oversimplifies the arbitration time limit. Even so, A's message to HR asks whether 800 is gross or take-home pay and asks for the deduction details, which B's message leaves out. A is accurate on the core numbers and B is not, so A wins clearly.
